column3: No retained Integer keys, TreeSet, TreeMap nodes or per-entry compatibility objects. IndexStore is one container per filter; Shape is the original shared semantic object.

column2: Existing TreeList AVL height/rotation/balance pattern specialized for int keys
column3: Insert is amortized O(log n), with occasional O(n) lane growth; contains is worst-case O(log n); successor traversal O(n); duplicate insertion does not change modification epoch.

column2: Original merge body retains upper-then-lower checks after processIndices
column3: False extractor return is ignored; invalid partial indexes remain queryable/copyable; errors propagate before any later modification check.
Capture next value before callback; check epoch after callback even on false; callback exception wins.

column2: Original enhanced-for next/check and tail sequence
column3: Check epoch before consuming a cached next slot. No extra check when no next slot remains or after trailing bitmap callbacks; false/exception exits retain original precedence.

column2: Independent complete primitive columns and same Shape
column3: No live slot/payload facade escapes. Clear changes epoch even empty and releases all arrays; copy preserves contents while allocating independent nonempty arrays.

column2: Dense slots; geometric growth; every new column allocated before publication
column3: Acquire at most one slot per distinct integer. Recursive child results are evaluated before re-reading a possibly grown child lane. Growth failure publishes no partial lane set.

No public/protected signature, BloomFilter default method, original test, receiver workflow, generic sorted delegate or concurrent owner change. Primitive capacity bounded by existing TreeList donor limit Integer.MAX_VALUE-8; no runtime footprint/throughput or concurrent guarantee.
